No write, push, comment, or"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" mutation capability exists anywhere in the package.
- **In-tool routing** — every request runs host"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"-side (outside the sandbox's TLS/proxy restrictions) and falls through a route ladder: `api.github.c"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"om` (direct → proxy) → `gh` CLI (read-only subcommands) → git protocol (plugin fetch cache, or a loc"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"al clone read with log/diff/show only) → PR/issue page HTML (strict JSON island extraction) → user-c"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"onfigured raw mirrors.
- **One call, structured outcome** — PRs come back with metadata, discussion,"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" reviews, commits, changed files, and the diff, each part annotated with the route that served it; f"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"ailures return a route matrix instead of a dozen retried shell commands.
- **Connectivity probe** — "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"`github_probe` reports which routes are live from the host in one call, with timings and a recommend"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ed route chain.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — peers resolve from the DSH profile; proxied reques"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ts travel through the plugin's own CONNECT tunnel (no third-party HTTP stack), so the package instal"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"ls fully offline.
